# MENASCO Projects

> Some of our feature projects. Select a category or location to bring it to the top of the portfolio.

## Sectors

- Residential / Commercial (84): Integrated engineering solutions for residential, commercial, office, and mixed-use developments.
- Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment (15): High-performance MEP delivery for premium hospitality, resort, cultural landmark, and entertainment destination environments.
- Advanced Technical Facilities (14): Specialist engineering for data centers, mission-critical, healthcare, energy, and technically demanding facilities.
- Infrastructure & Utilities (24): Category reserved for future projects — detailed scope has not yet been published.
